aiMetadata.description: Fires when an end user submits a SimplePDF form, delivering the completed PDF submission via webhook. The event represents a single form submission and includes the source document (id and name), the submission (id, submitted_at timestamp, and a URL to the filled PDF), and any context such as environment and customer_id.
